title: os deploy --dry-run against a runtime reads the install ledger file while the real install reads the database, so a host that kept its DB but lost .objectstack/ gets a clean plan and then a 409
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Found by a qa#3 routine round (owed:weekly) at objectstack main 0c2aeb96, beside the clauses of `cli.deploy-runtime-dry-run-json` (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8). Severity: low. No open issue covers it; related: #32913 (stating and pinning the moved install-local answers, the dry run among them).

## Reproduction (scaffold package `com.qa.deploy`, a showcase runtime booted with a file DB)

1. `os deploy` version 1.0.0 (object `qa_deploy_item` with a text field `note`) to the runtime → "Live: … now serves com.qa.deploy 1.0.0"; the runtime writes `.objectstack/installed-packages/com.qa.deploy.json` under its app directory and the package row into its DB.
2. Remove that one file (`.objectstack/installed-packages/com.qa.deploy.json`), leaving the database as it is — the shape of a host whose database volume persists but whose app directory does not.
3. Author 1.1.0 that renames `note` → `memo` without `renamedFrom`, then `os deploy --dry-run` → exit 0, "Version: 1.1.0 (not installed)", "Objects + qa_deploy_item", "Nothing in this plan asks for a confirmation".
4. `os deploy --json` (off-TTY) against the same runtime → exit 1, `result: "refused"`, 409 `SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, `installedVersion: "1.0.0"` (read from the DB).

Expected: the dry run answers what the install will answer — "installed: 1.0.0" and "would stop for your confirmation" — as it does when the file is present (re-run with the file restored: plan correct).

## Mechanism (from source, not proven by a pin)

The dry run's answer (`answerUpgradeDryRun` in the cloud-connection `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`) reads the on-disk install ledger (`this.ledger.read`), while the install gate reads the installed version from the database, so the two disagree whenever the ledger file and the DB drift apart.

QA-source: #33534 · cli.deploy-runtime-dry-run-json · observed beside the clauses
